messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "full therapeutic effect may take 5 weeks or longer for OCD"
set: ["full therapeutic effect may take 5 weeks or longer for OCD", "5 weeks or longer for full benefit in OCD", "full effect for depression may take 4 weeks or longer", "take regularly over several weeks for full pain-relieving effect", "it may take 4 weeks or longer before you feel the full benefit", "may take 1 to 4 days to reach its full effect", "5 weeks", "helps feel full longer", "longer than fluid effect", "take for 4 to 6 weeks before feeling full effects", "4 to 6 weeks for full effects", "results take longer", "effect seen on longer courses", "take for full prescribed length of time", "requires 1 to 2 weeks of regular dosing for full effect to build up", "can take several days of regular once-daily use before full effect"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
